messages:
allhands-bot: Post-all-hands thread: ask leadership anything about strategy.
jamie_ceo: Short answers here — will follow up in thread.
sam_product: Quick ask: where do we draw the line between product features that live in Redwood Optimize vs core runtime?
olivia_cto: Runtime handles per-token execution, batching, routing. Optimize is recommendations, profiles and automation. Keep runtime lean and robust; Optimize can iterate faster with ML-driven suggestions.
aria_engineer: Any change in priority for quantization support across Dedicated vs Private?\am jamie_ceo: Prioritize broad quant support for Dedicated since customers care about cost; ensure Private has same capabilities but rollout through opt-in builds.
noah_sales: How do we handle customers that demand model-specific fine-tuning on our infra?
zoe_marketing: For messaging: emphasize we support model variants and managed finetune partnerships, but we don’t host customer-owned fine-tune artifacts by default — discuss case-by-case.
jamie_ceo: Thanks — well publish guidelines.
allhands-bot: Thread closed in 2 hours.
